lines.text: A man in the church has his father's wife, and the Corinthians are proud instead of grieving.
Paul says to hand the man over to Satan so his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
Paul says a little leaven works through the whole batch, and Christ, our Pentecost lamb, has been sacrificed.
Paul says to keep the feast with the unleavened bread of fasting and prayer.
God will judge those outside, and Paul says to expel the wicked man from among you.
